rtk env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -c 'import re, subprocess, sys
pat = re.compile(r"^\s*#\s*(?:!|shellcheck\b|gitleaks:|tickets-boundary-ok:|raw-git-ok:|mechanism-ok:|pragma:|noqa\b|type:\s*ignore\b)", re.I)
def kept(ref, path):
    text = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{ref}:{path}"], text=True)
    return [line for line in text.splitlines() if pat.search(line)]
bad = [p for p in sys.argv[1:] if kept("HEAD^", p) != kept("HEAD", p)]
assert not bad, f"directive/shebang changes: {bad}"' infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh infra/scripts/bootstrap-gerrit-admin.sh infra/scripts/compose-up.sh infra/scripts/config-check.sh infra/scripts/fetch-secrets.sh infra/scripts/install-autodeploy.sh infra/scripts/install-certbot-timer.sh infra/scripts/materialize-mcp-upstream.sh infra/scripts/materialize-opcert-guard.sh infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh infra/scripts/observability.sh infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh
